problems.name: Concatenation of Array
problems.prompt: Return a new array containing the values of nums twice, in their original order.

problems.name: Contains Duplicate
problems.prompt: Decide whether any integer appears more than once in nums.

problems.name: Valid Anagram
problems.prompt: Decide whether rearranging the letters of s can produce t. The inputs use lowercase English letters.

problems.name: Two Sum
problems.prompt: Return the zero-based indices of two different entries whose values add up to target. Exactly one pair works. Either index order is accepted.

problems.name: Longest Common Prefix
problems.prompt: Return the longest starting sequence shared by every string. If their first letters already differ, return an empty string.

problems.name: Group Anagrams
problems.prompt: Group words that have the same letter counts. Return an array of groups. The order of the groups and of words within them is free.

problems.name: Remove Element
problems.prompt: Overwrite the start of nums with all entries unequal to val and return the number of retained entries. Their order is free.

problems.name: Majority Element
problems.prompt: Find the integer occurring in more than half of the positions. Such an integer always exists.

problems.name: Design HashSet
problems.prompt: Implement a set for integer keys without a built-in set or map. Adding a present key or removing an absent key has no effect. contains returns a boolean.

problems.name: Design HashMap
problems.prompt: Store nonnegative integer values by integer key without a built-in map. put inserts or overwrites, get returns -1 for an absent key, and remove discards the entry.

problems.name: Sort an Array
problems.prompt: Return the integers in ascending order. Implement the sorting algorithm yourself.

problems.name: Sort Colors
problems.prompt: Partition the array in place so that all zeroes precede the ones, followed by the twos. The runner reads nums after the call if you return nothing.

problems.name: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.prompt: Return the k most frequent distinct values in any order. The cutoff is unambiguous.

problems.name: Encode and Decode Strings
problems.prompt: Design a reversible representation of a string array. encode must produce a string that decode can unpack independently, including empty strings and punctuation. The samples show the decoded result.

problems.name: Range Sum Query 2D Immutable
problems.prompt: Preprocess an integer matrix. For each sumRegion call, return the sum inside the inclusive rectangle between the supplied zero-based corners.

problems.name: Product of Array Except Self
problems.prompt: At every index return the product of all other entries. Use linear time without division.

problems.name: Valid Sudoku
problems.prompt: Check the filled digits on a 9-by-9 board. A digit may appear at most once in its row, column, and 3-by-3 box. A dot marks an empty cell. Each sample row is a string.

problems.name: Longest Consecutive Sequence
problems.prompt: Return the length of the longest run of consecutive integer values present in the array, independent of input order. Aim for linear time.

problems.name: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock II
problems.prompt: Maximize total profit over as many buy-then-sell trades as you like. Hold at most one share at a time.

problems.name: Majority Element II
problems.prompt: Return all values occurring strictly more than one third of the time, in any order.

problems.name: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.prompt: Count contiguous nonempty slices whose values sum to k. Entries may be negative.

problems.name: First Missing Positive
problems.prompt: Find the smallest positive integer missing from nums. Target linear time and constant extra space.

problems.name: Reverse String
problems.prompt: Reverse the character array in place. The runner reads chars after the call if you return nothing.

problems.name: Valid Palindrome
problems.prompt: Ignore punctuation, spaces, and letter case. Return whether the remaining alphanumeric characters read the same in both directions.

problems.name: Valid Palindrome II
problems.prompt: Decide whether deleting at most one character can turn text into a palindrome.

problems.name: Merge Strings Alternately
problems.prompt: Take one character from a, then one from b, and repeat. Append the unused suffix when one string runs out.

problems.name: Merge Sorted Array
problems.prompt: Merge sorted nums2 into nums1 in ascending order. Only the first m entries of nums1 initially contain data, with n spare slots at the end. The runner reads nums1 if you return nothing.

problems.name: Remove Duplicates From Sorted Array
problems.prompt: Compact the sorted array in place so its prefix contains each distinct value once in ascending order. Return the length of this prefix.

problems.name: Two Sum II Input Array Is Sorted
problems.prompt: Find two entries in the sorted array that add up to target. Return their one-based indices in increasing order.

problems.name: 3Sum
problems.prompt: Return each distinct triple of values with sum zero, using three different indices. Ordering of triples and their entries is free.

problems.name: 4Sum
problems.prompt: Return the distinct groups of four values that sum to target using different indices. Ordering is free.

problems.name: Rotate Array
problems.prompt: Move each value k positions to the right, wrapping at the end. Update nums in place. The runner reads nums if you return nothing.

problems.name: Container With Most Water
problems.prompt: Choose two vertical lines to form a container. Return the largest distance between lines times the shorter height.

problems.name: Boats to Save People
problems.prompt: Each boat holds at most two people and their total weight must be at most limit. Find the fewest boats needed. Every individual fits.

problems.name: Trapping Rain Water
problems.prompt: Treat heights as adjacent unit-width bars. Return how many units of rain can pool between them.

problems.name: Contains Duplicate II
problems.prompt: Return whether equal values appear at two distinct indices at most k positions apart.

problems.name: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock
problems.prompt: Choose at most one buy followed by one sale on a later day. Return the largest profit, or zero if all trades lose money.

problems.name: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.prompt: Find the maximum length of a contiguous substring containing no repeated character.

problems.name: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problems.prompt: Change up to k uppercase letters. Find the longest substring you can make entirely one letter.

problems.name: Permutation In String
problems.prompt: Return whether a contiguous window of text is a rearrangement of pattern.

problems.name: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
problems.prompt: Find the shortest nonempty contiguous slice of positive numbers whose sum reaches target. Return zero if no slice qualifies.

problems.name: Find K Closest Elements
problems.prompt: Return the k closest values to x from the sorted array, breaking distance ties in favor of the smaller value. Output in ascending order.

problems.name: Minimum Window Substring
problems.prompt: Find the shortest substring containing every character of pattern with its required multiplicity. Return an empty string if impossible.

problems.name: Sliding Window Maximum
problems.prompt: Return the maximum in each consecutive window of k entries, from left to right.

problems.name: Baseball Game
problems.prompt: Keep a stack of scores. Integers append scores, C removes the last, D appends twice the last, and + appends the sum of the last two. Return the final total.

problems.name: Valid Parentheses
problems.prompt: Decide whether round, square, and curly brackets are correctly matched and nested.

problems.name: Implement Stack Using Queues
problems.prompt: Implement a last-in, first-out stack using queue operations. pop removes and returns the top item. top only reads it.

problems.name: Implement Queue using Stacks
problems.prompt: Implement a first-in, first-out queue using stack operations. peek reads the front, while pop removes and returns it.

problems.name: Min Stack
problems.prompt: Support stack updates, top lookup, and minimum lookup in constant time. pop removes the top without returning it.

problems.name: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
problems.prompt: Evaluate postfix arithmetic with +, -, *, and /. Integer division truncates toward zero.

problems.name: Generate Parentheses
problems.prompt: Return all balanced strings made from exactly n pairs of round parentheses, in any order.

problems.name: Asteroid Collision
problems.prompt: Positive asteroids travel right and negative ones travel left. When they meet, the smaller absolute size disappears, or both disappear on a tie. Return the survivors in order.

problems.name: Daily Temperatures
problems.prompt: For each day return the number of days until a strictly warmer temperature, or zero if none follows.

problems.name: Online Stock Span
problems.prompt: For each arriving price return the number of consecutive days ending today whose prices never exceed today's price.

problems.name: Car Fleet
problems.prompt: Cars travel toward target on a single lane. When a faster car catches one ahead, the fleet continues at the slower speed. Count fleets reaching the target.

problems.name: Simplify Path
problems.prompt: Normalize an absolute Unix path. Collapse extra slashes, ignore single dots, and use double dots to step toward the root.

problems.name: Decode String
problems.prompt: Expand nested repetition expressions of the form count[sequence]. Literal letters remain in order.

problems.name: Maximum Frequency Stack
problems.prompt: Pop the most frequent value currently present. Among tied values remove the one most recently pushed.

problems.name: Largest Rectangle In Histogram
problems.prompt: Find the maximum area of a rectangle covered by consecutive unit-width bars in a histogram.

problems.name: Binary Search
problems.prompt: Find target in an ascending array of distinct integers in logarithmic time. Return its zero-based index or -1 when it is absent.

problems.name: Search Insert Position
problems.prompt: In a sorted array of distinct values, return the index of target or the index where it belongs.

problems.name: Guess Number Higher Or Lower
problems.prompt: Locate the secret integer between 1 and n. Call guess(value) to receive -1 for too high, 1 for too low, or 0 for correct. The second sample argument represents the secret behind that callback.

problems.name: Sqrt(x)
problems.prompt: Return the integer part of the nonnegative square root without using a square-root or fractional-power operation.

problems.name: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.prompt: Rows are sorted, and each row begins above the last value of the preceding row. Search for target in logarithmic time and return a boolean.

problems.name: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.prompt: Each hour you may eat up to k bananas from one pile. Find the smallest integer k that empties every pile within h hours.

problems.name: Capacity to Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.prompt: Ship the packages in the given order. Find the least daily weight capacity that finishes within days days.

problems.name: Find Minimum In Rotated Sorted Array
problems.prompt: A strictly increasing array was rotated. Locate its minimum value in logarithmic time.

problems.name: Search In Rotated Sorted Array
problems.prompt: Search a rotated ascending array of distinct values. Return the target index, or -1. Aim for logarithmic time.

problems.name: Search In Rotated Sorted Array II
problems.prompt: Decide whether target occurs in a rotated, nondecreasing array that may contain duplicates.

problems.name: Time Based Key Value Store
problems.prompt: Save timestamped strings. get reads the most recent value at or before the requested time, or an empty string. Writes arrive in increasing time order.

problems.name: Split Array Largest Sum
problems.prompt: Split the nonnegative integers into exactly k nonempty contiguous groups. Minimize the largest group sum.

problems.name: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problems.prompt: Find the median of the combined values from two sorted arrays. For an even total, average the two middle values.

problems.name: Find in Mountain Array
problems.prompt: Find the first index of target in a strictly rising then strictly falling mountain. Use mountain.get(index) and mountain.length(). Return -1 when absent. Samples display the underlying array.

problems.name: Reverse Linked List
problems.prompt: Reverse the direction of a singly linked list and return its new head.

problems.name: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.prompt: Merge two sorted singly linked lists and return the first node of the combined sorted list.

problems.name: Linked List Cycle
problems.prompt: Decide whether following next pointers eventually visits the same node twice. Sample input is a list of values and the zero-based index joined by the tail, or -1.

problems.name: Reorder List
problems.prompt: Rewire the list by alternating the first remaining node with the last remaining node. The runner reads head after the call if you return nothing.

problems.name: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.prompt: Remove the nth node counted from the tail, with n=1 referring to the tail itself. Return the updated head.

problems.name: Copy List With Random Pointer
problems.prompt: Deep-copy the list including its random pointers. Samples use [value, randomIndex] per node, with null for an empty random pointer. Return the copied head. Use Node(val) with next and random fields.

problems.name: Add Two Numbers
problems.prompt: Add two numbers stored as linked lists of decimal digits with the least significant digit first. Return the sum in the same representation.

problems.name: Find The Duplicate Number
problems.prompt: There are n+1 entries, each between 1 and n. Find the only value appearing multiple times without changing nums and using constant extra space.

problems.name: Reverse Linked List II
problems.prompt: Reverse the segment between one-based positions left and right, inclusive, and return the updated head.

problems.name: Design Circular Queue
problems.prompt: Implement a bounded FIFO queue. enQueue and deQueue report success. Front and Rear return -1 on an empty queue.

problems.name: LRU Cache
problems.prompt: Maintain a fixed-capacity cache. Successful reads and writes mark entries as recently used. Evict the least recently used entry when needed. Missing reads return -1.

problems.name: LFU Cache
problems.prompt: Evict the least frequently accessed entry when inserting into a full cache, breaking ties by least recent access. New keys start at frequency one. Existing-key writes and successful reads increase frequency. Missing reads return -1.

problems.name: Merge K Sorted Lists
problems.prompt: Combine an array of sorted linked-list heads into a single sorted list and return its head.

problems.name: Reverse Nodes In K Group
problems.prompt: Reverse each complete group of k consecutive nodes. Leave a shorter final group in its original order and return the new head.

problems.name: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
problems.prompt: Visit left subtree, node, then right subtree. Return node values in that order.

problems.name: Binary Tree Preorder Traversal
problems.prompt: Visit node, left subtree, then right subtree. Return node values in that order.

problems.name: Binary Tree Postorder Traversal
problems.prompt: Visit left subtree, right subtree, then node. Return node values in that order.

problems.name: Invert Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Exchange the left and right subtrees at every node and return the resulting root.

problems.name: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Count the nodes along the longest path from root to a leaf. The depth of an empty tree is zero.

problems.name: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Find the greatest number of edges in a simple path joining any two nodes.

problems.name: Balanced Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Return whether at every node the left and right subtree heights differ by at most one.

problems.name: Same Tree
problems.prompt: Compare the two trees for identical shape and corresponding node values.

problems.name: Subtree of Another Tree
problems.prompt: Decide whether some node in root starts a subtree identical in shape and values to subRoot.

problems.name: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
problems.prompt: p and q are distinct values present in the binary search tree. Return the value of their deepest common ancestor, allowing either target itself.

problems.name: Insert into a Binary Search Tree
problems.prompt: Insert a previously absent value into the binary search tree by following comparisons to an empty child. Return its root.

problems.name: Delete Node in a BST
problems.prompt: Remove key if present while preserving the binary search order. Return the root of any valid result.

problems.name: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.prompt: Read each level from left to right and return an array of levels from top to bottom.

problems.name: Binary Tree Right Side View
problems.prompt: Return the rightmost visible value at each depth, going down from the root.

problems.name: Construct Quad Tree
problems.prompt: Compress a square binary grid of power-of-two size. Represent a uniform region by its numeric value, otherwise return four recursively encoded quadrants in top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right order.

problems.name: Count Good Nodes In Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Count nodes whose value is at least every value on their path from the root. Include the root itself.

problems.name: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.prompt: Check that every node lies strictly within the bounds imposed by all of its ancestors in a binary search tree.

problems.name: Kth Smallest Element In a Bst
problems.prompt: Return the kth smallest node value in a binary search tree, counting from one.

problems.name: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder And Inorder Traversal
problems.prompt: Rebuild a tree with distinct values from its preorder and inorder traversals. Return its root.

problems.name: House Robber III
problems.prompt: Choose tree nodes with maximum total value, subject to never choosing a node and its immediate parent together. Return the total.

problems.name: Delete Leaves With a Given Value
problems.prompt: Remove leaves equal to target, repeating when their parents become eligible leaves. Return the surviving root.

problems.name: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.prompt: Maximize the sum of node values on any nonempty simple path in the tree. The path can start and end at any nodes.

problems.name: Serialize And Deserialize Binary Tree
problems.prompt: Design a string format for binary trees that preserves their values and structure. A fresh codec must reconstruct the tree from your serialized string.

problems.name: Kth Largest Element In a Stream
problems.prompt: Keep the kth largest value of a stream, counting duplicates. add inserts a value and returns the new kth largest.

problems.name: Last Stone Weight
problems.prompt: Repeatedly smash the two heaviest stones together. Equal stones disappear, otherwise the difference remains. Return the last weight or zero.

problems.name: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.prompt: Return the k points nearest the origin by Euclidean distance, in any order. The cutoff is unambiguous.

problems.name: Kth Largest Element In An Array
problems.prompt: Find the kth largest entry, counting duplicate occurrences separately.

problems.name: Task Scheduler
problems.prompt: A CPU completes one task per time slot. Repeated task letters need at least n intervening slots. Return the minimum schedule length including idle slots.

problems.name: Design Twitter
problems.prompt: Build a feed with the ten most recent tweet IDs by the user or accounts they currently follow, newest first.

problems.name: Single Threaded CPU
problems.prompt: Each pair gives a release time and processing time. When free, the CPU picks the shortest available task, breaking ties by original index. Return execution order as indices.

problems.name: Reorganize String
problems.prompt: Rearrange the letters so neighbors always differ, or return an empty string if impossible. Any valid arrangement is accepted.

problems.name: Longest Happy String
problems.prompt: Build the longest string using up to a copies of a, b copies of b, and c copies of c. Three equal letters in a row are forbidden. Any longest valid answer is accepted.

problems.name: Car Pooling
problems.prompt: A trip is [passengers, start, end]. Passengers leave before anyone boards at the same stop. Decide whether all trips fit.

problems.name: Find Median From Data Stream
problems.prompt: Track numbers as they arrive. Return the middle value of all numbers seen, averaging the middle pair when the count is even.

problems.name: IPO
problems.prompt: Choose up to k distinct projects. You can start a project when current capital reaches its requirement, and completing it adds its profit. Return maximum final capital.

problems.name: Sum of All Subsets XOR Total
problems.prompt: Compute the bitwise XOR of each subset and sum those results. The empty subset contributes zero.

problems.name: Subsets
problems.prompt: Return the power set of distinct input values, including the empty subset. Subset and output order are free.

problems.name: Combination Sum
problems.prompt: List all distinct combinations of positive candidates totaling target. A candidate can be used repeatedly. Ignore ordering.

problems.name: Combination Sum II
problems.prompt: List all distinct combinations totaling target. Each input occurrence can be used once, and duplicate combinations count only once.

problems.name: Combinations
problems.prompt: Choose k distinct integers from 1 through n. Return all possible groups in any order.

problems.name: Permutations
problems.prompt: Return every ordering of the distinct input values, with each value used once per ordering.

problems.name: Subsets II
problems.prompt: List all distinct subsets of the input multiset. Duplicate values are allowed inside a subset if the input supplies them.

problems.name: Permutations II
problems.prompt: Return every distinct ordering of the input multiset once.

problems.name: Word Search
problems.prompt: Trace word through horizontally or vertically adjacent board cells. Each cell is usable at most once per path. Return whether a path exists. Rows are character arrays.

problems.name: Palindrome Partitioning
problems.prompt: Split text into palindromic substrings. Return every partition, keeping the pieces of each partition in their original order.

problems.name: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
problems.prompt: Map digits 2 through 9 to the letters on a standard telephone keypad. Return all letter strings made by choosing one letter per digit. An empty input produces no strings.

problems.name: Matchsticks to Square
problems.prompt: Use every stick exactly once, without cutting it. Decide whether four equal-length sides can be formed by grouping sticks.

problems.name: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
problems.prompt: Decide whether all positive entries can be split into k nonempty groups of equal sum.

problems.name: N Queens
problems.prompt: Return every distinct arrangement of n nonattacking queens on an n-by-n board. Represent a board by row strings using Q and a dot.

problems.name: N Queens II
problems.prompt: Count the ways to place n queens on an n-by-n board without sharing a row, column, or diagonal.

problems.name: Word Break II
problems.prompt: Insert spaces so every piece belongs to words. Return all possible sentences. Words can be reused.

problems.name: Implement Trie Prefix Tree
problems.prompt: Implement a trie supporting full-word lookup and prefix lookup for inserted lowercase words.

problems.name: Design Add And Search Words Data Structure
problems.prompt: Store words and support full-word searches where a dot matches any one letter.

problems.name: Extra Characters in a String
problems.prompt: Cover parts of text with nonoverlapping dictionary words. Return the fewest characters left uncovered. Words can be reused.

problems.name: Word Search II
problems.prompt: Return the dictionary words traceable through orthogonally adjacent cells, without reusing a cell in a single trace. Return each found word once in any order.

problems.name: Island Perimeter
problems.prompt: Ones form one connected island without lakes. Count its unit edges exposed to water or the outside of the grid.

problems.name: Verifying An Alien Dictionary
problems.prompt: The string order ranks all lowercase letters. Decide whether words are lexicographically sorted under that ranking, using the usual shorter-prefix rule.

problems.name: Find the Town Judge
problems.prompt: Each [a,b] means person a trusts b. Return the person trusted by everyone else who trusts no one, or -1. People are numbered 1 through n.

problems.name: Number of Islands
problems.prompt: Count orthogonally connected groups of land. The grid contains character cells, with "1" for land and "0" for water.

problems.name: Max Area of Island
problems.prompt: In a binary grid, find the size of the largest four-connected region of ones. Return zero for all water.

problems.name: Clone Graph
problems.prompt: Deep-copy an undirected connected graph starting at node. Each Node has val and neighbors. Samples show adjacency lists for labels 1 through n. Return the copied start node or null.

problems.name: Walls And Gates
problems.prompt: Each cell is a wall (-1), gate (0), or empty room (2147483647). Fill each room with its shortest four-direction distance to a gate. Keep unreachable rooms unchanged. The runner reads rooms if you return nothing.

problems.name: Rotting Oranges
problems.prompt: Each minute, rotten oranges (2) spoil adjacent fresh oranges (1) in four directions. Empty cells are zero. Return minutes until all are rotten, or -1 if impossible.

problems.name: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
problems.prompt: Water moves to orthogonal neighbors at equal or lower elevation. Return cells that can reach both the top/left ocean and the bottom/right ocean as [row,column] pairs in any order.

problems.name: Surrounded Regions
problems.prompt: Replace O cells enclosed by X with X. Preserve O regions connected to an edge through four-direction moves. The runner reads board if you return nothing.

problems.name: Open The Lock
problems.prompt: Starting at 0000, turn one wheel one step per move, wrapping between 0 and 9. Avoid deadend combinations. Return the fewest moves to target, or -1.

problems.name: Course Schedule
problems.prompt: Each pair [course, prerequisite] gives a requirement. Decide whether all n courses can be completed. Courses use indices 0 through n-1.

problems.name: Course Schedule II
problems.prompt: Return any order completing all n courses, with the second entry in each prerequisite pair before its first. Return an empty array when impossible.

problems.name: Graph Valid Tree
problems.prompt: Determine whether undirected edges on vertices 0 through n-1 form a single tree.

problems.name: Course Schedule IV
problems.prompt: Here [a,b] means a must precede b. For each query [u,v], return whether u is a direct or indirect prerequisite of v.

problems.name: Number of Connected Components In An Undirected Graph
problems.prompt: Count connected components in an undirected graph with vertices 0 through n-1, including isolated vertices.

problems.name: Redundant Connection
problems.prompt: A tree gained one extra undirected edge. Return the last input edge whose removal would restore a tree.

problems.name: Accounts Merge
problems.prompt: Each row begins with a name and then emails. Merge accounts connected by shared emails. Place the name first and sorted distinct emails after it. Rows may be in any order.

problems.name: Evaluate Division
problems.prompt: Each equation [a,b] gives the ratio a/b in the matching values entry. Evaluate each query ratio, returning -1 when it cannot be inferred.

problems.name: Minimum Height Trees
problems.prompt: Return all vertices that minimize the height when used as the root of the given undirected tree. Any order is accepted.

problems.name: Word Ladder
problems.prompt: Change one letter per step using only dictionary words after the starting word. Return the number of words in the shortest route to end, or zero if no route exists.

problems.name: Path with Minimum Effort
problems.prompt: Walk from the top-left to the bottom-right through orthogonal neighbors. Minimize the largest absolute height change of any single step.

problems.name: Network Delay Time
problems.prompt: Each directed edge [u,v,time] carries a signal with the supplied delay. Starting at one-based vertex start, return when all n vertices receive the signal, or -1.

problems.name: Reconstruct Itinerary
problems.prompt: Start at JFK and use each directed ticket exactly once. Return the lexicographically smallest valid sequence of airports. A complete route exists.

problems.name: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problems.prompt: Connect every point using links priced by Manhattan distance. Return the minimum total cost of a connected network.

problems.name: Swim In Rising Water
problems.prompt: A cell becomes accessible when the water reaches its elevation. Return the earliest time a four-direction path connects the top-left and bottom-right cells.

problems.name: Alien Dictionary
problems.prompt: Infer one valid ordering of all distinct letters in this sorted alien dictionary. Return an empty string when the words are inconsistent.

problems.name: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.prompt: A flight is [from,to,price]. Find the least total price from src to dst using at most k intermediate stops, or return -1.

problems.name: Find Critical and Pseudo Critical Edges in Minimum Spanning Tree
problems.prompt: Edges are [u,v,weight] with zero-based input indices. Return [critical, pseudoCritical] index lists. Critical edges occur in every minimum spanning tree, pseudo-critical edges in some but not all. Each list may be in any order.

problems.name: Build a Matrix With Conditions
problems.prompt: Put 1 through k into distinct cells of a k-by-k zero-filled matrix. Each row pair [a,b] requires a strictly above b, and each column pair requires a strictly left of b. Return any solution, or [] if impossible.

problems.name: Greatest Common Divisor Traversal
problems.prompt: Two indices are connected when their values share a divisor greater than one. Decide whether every index can reach every other through such links.

problems.name: Climbing Stairs
problems.prompt: Count the distinct sequences of one- and two-step moves that climb exactly n stairs.

problems.name: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
problems.prompt: You may start at step 0 or 1. Pay a step's cost when leaving it and move up one or two steps. Return the least total cost to reach just beyond the last step.

problems.name: N-th Tribonacci Number
problems.prompt: Use T0=0, T1=T2=1. Each later term is the sum of its three predecessors. Return Tn.

problems.name: House Robber
problems.prompt: Choose nonadjacent houses in a line to maximize the sum of their values. Return that sum.

problems.name: House Robber II
problems.prompt: Choose nonadjacent houses arranged in a circle. The first and last houses are neighbors. Return the largest obtainable total.

problems.name: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.prompt: Return a longest contiguous substring that reads identically in both directions. Any answer tied for maximum length is accepted.

problems.name: Palindromic Substrings
problems.prompt: Count all palindromic nonempty substrings, counting different positions separately.

problems.name: Decode Ways
problems.prompt: Count ways to decode digits using 1=A through 26=Z. An encoding cannot use a leading zero in any token.

problems.name: Coin Change
problems.prompt: Use unlimited coins of the listed denominations to make amount with the fewest coins. Return -1 when impossible.

problems.name: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.prompt: Return the largest product of a contiguous, nonempty part of nums.

problems.name: Word Break
problems.prompt: Decide whether text can be divided completely into dictionary words, allowing reuse.

problems.name: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.prompt: Find the length of a longest strictly increasing subsequence. Selected entries need not be adjacent.

problems.name: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.prompt: Decide whether the positive integers can be divided into two groups with equal sums.

problems.name: Combination Sum IV
problems.prompt: Count ordered sequences of positive numbers from nums that sum to target. Each value can be chosen repeatedly.

problems.name: Perfect Squares
problems.prompt: Find the smallest number of positive perfect squares whose sum is n. Squares may repeat.

problems.name: Integer Break
problems.prompt: Split n into at least two positive integers. Return the largest product of their values.

problems.name: Stone Game III
problems.prompt: Players alternate taking one to three stones from the front and earn their sum. Both play optimally. Return Alice, Bob, or Tie depending on the final scores.

problems.name: Unique Paths
problems.prompt: Count routes from the top-left to the bottom-right of an m-by-n grid using only right and down moves.

problems.name: Unique Paths II
problems.prompt: Count top-left to bottom-right paths moving right or down, avoiding cells marked 1. Zero marks an open cell.

problems.name: Minimum Path Sum
problems.prompt: Starting in the top-left, move only right and down to the bottom-right. Minimize the sum of visited cells including the endpoints.

problems.name: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.prompt: Return the longest length obtainable by deleting characters from each string so the two remaining sequences match.

problems.name: Last Stone Weight II
problems.prompt: Smash any two stones, replacing them by their absolute difference. Return the smallest possible final weight, counting an empty result as zero.

problems.name: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock With Cooldown
problems.prompt: Maximize stock profit holding at most one share. After a sale, the next day must pass before another purchase.

problems.name: Coin Change II
problems.prompt: Count distinct combinations of unlimited coins totaling amount. Reordering the same coins does not create a new combination.

problems.name: Target Sum
problems.prompt: Place + or - before every entry. Count sign assignments whose resulting sum equals target.

problems.name: Interleaving String
problems.prompt: Decide whether merged interleaves all of a and b while preserving each string's internal order.

problems.name: Stone Game
problems.prompt: Two players take turns choosing a pile from either end. All piles are positive, their count is even, and their total is odd. Return whether the first player wins with optimal play.

problems.name: Stone Game II
problems.prompt: Begin with M=1. Each turn, take the first X piles for any X from 1 to 2M, then set M to max(M,X). Return the first player's optimal total stones.

problems.name: Longest Increasing Path In a Matrix
problems.prompt: Return the greatest number of cells on a strictly increasing path through orthogonal neighbors.

problems.name: Distinct Subsequences
problems.prompt: Count ways to select increasing positions from text that spell target. Different index selections count separately.

problems.name: Edit Distance
problems.prompt: Find the smallest number of single-character insertions, deletions, or replacements needed to turn a into b.

problems.name: Burst Balloons
problems.prompt: Bursting a balloon earns its value times the values of its current neighbors. Treat missing neighbors as 1. Find the maximum coins after bursting all balloons.

problems.name: Regular Expression Matching
problems.prompt: Match the entire text. A dot matches one character and a star allows zero or more occurrences of the preceding element.

problems.name: Lemonade Change
problems.prompt: Each drink costs 5. Starting with an empty till, give each customer exact change from earlier bills. Payments are 5, 10, or 20. Return whether all sales succeed.

problems.name: Maximum Subarray
problems.prompt: Find the greatest sum of a contiguous, nonempty portion of the array.

problems.name: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
problems.prompt: Maximize a nonempty contiguous sum on a circular array. Each position may be included at most once.

problems.name: Longest Turbulent Subarray
problems.prompt: Find the longest contiguous segment whose adjacent comparisons alternate strictly between greater than and less than. A single element qualifies.

problems.name: Jump Game
problems.prompt: From index i, jump forward by up to nums[i] positions. Decide whether the last index is reachable from index zero.

problems.name: Jump Game II
problems.prompt: Find the minimum number of forward jumps required to reach the last index. Each value bounds the jump from that position. The end is reachable.

problems.name: Jump Game VII
problems.prompt: Start at index zero. Jump forward between minJump and maxJump positions inclusive, landing only on zero characters. Decide whether the last index is reachable.

problems.name: Gas Station
problems.prompt: At station i, collect gas[i] and spend cost[i] to reach the next station on a circle. Return a feasible starting index for a full trip from an empty tank, or -1. The feasible start is unique if present.

problems.name: Hand of Straights
problems.prompt: Decide whether all cards can be partitioned into groups of groupSize consecutive values.

problems.name: Dota2 Senate
problems.prompt: Senators act in circular order. Each active senator can ban an opponent from future turns. R and D play optimally for their parties. Return Radiant or Dire for the winning side.

problems.name: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
problems.prompt: Merge selected triplets by taking coordinate-wise maxima. Decide whether you can produce target exactly.

problems.name: Partition Labels
problems.prompt: Split text into as many nonempty parts as possible while keeping every occurrence of each letter in the same part. Return the part lengths.

problems.name: Valid Parenthesis String
problems.prompt: Each star can be an opening parenthesis, closing parenthesis, or empty string. Decide whether some choices make the entire sequence balanced.

problems.name: Candy
problems.prompt: Give each child at least one candy. Children with a higher rating than an adjacent child need more candy than that neighbor. Return the minimum total.

problems.name: Insert Interval
problems.prompt: Insert a closed interval into a sorted list of disjoint closed intervals. Merge every overlap and return the sorted result.

problems.name: Merge Intervals
problems.prompt: Merge overlapping closed intervals and return nonoverlapping intervals sorted by their start.

problems.name: Non Overlapping Intervals
problems.prompt: Remove as few intervals as possible so the rest do not overlap. Touching at an endpoint is allowed. Return the removal count.

problems.name: Meeting Rooms
problems.prompt: Decide whether one person can attend every meeting. A meeting ending exactly when another starts is compatible.

problems.name: Meeting Rooms II
problems.prompt: Return the minimum room count needed for all meetings. A room can be reused at the instant its previous meeting ends.

problems.name: Meeting Rooms III
problems.prompt: Rooms are indexed from zero. In start-time order, assign each meeting to the lowest available room, delaying it until the earliest release if necessary while preserving its duration. Break release ties by room index. Return the most-used room, breaking ties by index.

problems.name: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
problems.prompt: For each query point, return the inclusive integer length of the shortest closed interval containing it, or -1. Preserve query order.

problems.name: Excel Sheet Column Title
problems.prompt: Convert a positive column number to spreadsheet letters, where 1 is A, 26 is Z, and 27 is AA.

problems.name: Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
problems.prompt: Return the longest string whose exact repetitions form both inputs, or an empty string if they share none.

problems.name: Insert Greatest Common Divisors in Linked List
problems.prompt: Insert a new node between each original adjacent pair, using the greatest common divisor of their values. Return the head.

problems.name: Transpose Matrix
problems.prompt: Exchange the rows and columns of the rectangular matrix and return the result.

problems.name: Rotate Image
problems.prompt: Rotate the square matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place. The runner reads matrix after the call if you return nothing.

problems.name: Spiral Matrix
problems.prompt: Visit the matrix clockwise in a spiral starting at its top-left corner. Return the visited values in sequence.

problems.name: Set Matrix Zeroes
problems.prompt: For each zero in the original matrix, set its entire row and column to zero. Update the matrix in place. The runner reads matrix if you return nothing.

problems.name: Happy Number
problems.prompt: Repeatedly replace n by the sum of the squares of its decimal digits. Return whether the sequence reaches 1.

problems.name: Plus One
problems.prompt: Increment the nonnegative integer stored as decimal digits, most significant digit first. Return the resulting digits.

problems.name: Roman to Integer
problems.prompt: Convert a valid Roman numeral to an integer, including standard subtractive pairs such as IV and CM.

problems.name: Pow(x, n)
problems.prompt: Compute x raised to integer exponent n, handling negative exponents. Use exponentiation by squaring.

problems.name: Multiply Strings
problems.prompt: Multiply two nonnegative integers supplied as decimal strings. Return the decimal result without converting an entire input to a numeric type.

problems.name: Detect Squares
problems.prompt: Store points including duplicates. For a query point count selections of three stored occurrences that form an axis-aligned square of positive area with it.

problems.name: Single Number
problems.prompt: Every integer except one occurs exactly twice. Return the unpaired integer using constant extra space.

problems.name: Number of 1 Bits
problems.prompt: Count the bits equal to one in the unsigned 32-bit representation of n.

problems.name: Counting Bits
problems.prompt: Return the population count of every integer from 0 through n, indexed by the integer.

problems.name: Add Binary
problems.prompt: Add the two binary strings and return their sum in binary with no unnecessary leading zeroes.

problems.name: Reverse Bits
problems.prompt: Reverse all 32 bit positions of an unsigned integer. Return the resulting unsigned value.

problems.name: Missing Number
problems.prompt: The array has n distinct integers drawn from 0 through n. Return the one missing integer.

problems.name: Sum of Two Integers
problems.prompt: Add two signed integers without using the arithmetic addition or subtraction operators for the computation.

problems.name: Reverse Integer
problems.prompt: Reverse the decimal digits of a signed 32-bit integer and preserve its sign. Return zero if the reversed value falls outside signed 32-bit range.

problems.name: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range
problems.prompt: Compute the bitwise AND of every integer in the inclusive nonnegative range from left to right.

problems.name: Minimum Array End
problems.prompt: Form a strictly increasing sequence of n positive integers whose bitwise AND is x. Return the smallest possible final value. Sample results fit in a JavaScript safe integer.
